answer: A farm cannot grind its texts against a known seed, because the tundra value does not exist until the window has already shut. Because the sparrow beacon round is committed in advance, the voyage audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 23 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. That is 5 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
